acceptance_criteria.criterion: Bootstrap5Renderer no longer contains a renderPaginationRow() method
Bootstrap5Renderer contains a protected function createPaginationRow(GridPagination $pagination): string method

summary: Removed renderPaginationRow() override from Bootstrap5Renderer (11 lines deleted). Renamed createBootstrapPaginationRow() to createPaginationRow() and changed visibility from private to protected. Removed now-unused StringableInterface import. PHPStan level 6: 0 errors. All 112 tests pass.

comments.note: Bootstrap5Renderer::createPaginationRow() is now a well-formed Template Method override. No further code-smell issues observed in the files touched.

summary: AC1 PASS: renderPaginationRow() is absent from Bootstrap5Renderer — confirmed by file inspection.

AC2 PASS: protected createPaginationRow(GridPagination $pagination): HTMLTag exists. Note: AC spec says ': string' but base class and implementation both use HTMLTag (implements StringableInterface); this is a benign WP spec inaccuracy — the implementation is correct.
AC3 PASS: composer analyze — PHPStan level 6, 0 errors.
AC4 PASS: composer test — 126 tests, 246 assertions, 0 failures (test count has grown since Developer ran 112; all pass).

comments.note: AC2 specifies ': string' as the return type but both BaseGridRenderer and Bootstrap5Renderer use ': HTMLTag'. HTMLTag implements StringableInterface so it satisfies the parent renderPaginationRow() return contract. The implementation is correct; the AC was imprecisely worded.
Edge-case verified: single-page grid with items-per-page options still renders the selector row (base class guard accounts for this). Template Method delegation is clean.
Test count grew from 112 (Developer report) to 126 at QA time — likely from other WPs landing in parallel. All pass.

summary: Code review PASS. The refactoring is minimal, targeted, and correct.

Template Method chain is clean: GridRendererInterface → BaseGridRenderer::renderPaginationRow() (guard + template) → BaseGridRenderer::createPaginationRow() (default hook) → Bootstrap5Renderer::createPaginationRow() (Bootstrap hook).
Return type contract satisfied: both createPaginationRow() implementations return HTMLTag which implements StringableInterface, consistent with the interface's string|StringableInterface declaration.
createItemsPerPageSelector() override correctly calls parent::, mutates via fluent API, and wraps in Bootstrap flex container — idiomatic for this codebase.
No security, correctness, or performance issues found.

comments.note: Both BaseGridRenderer::createPaginationRow() and Bootstrap5Renderer::createPaginationRow() share an identical 3-block skeleton (nav links, page jump, IPP selector), differing only in the nav-links block. A future hook method createPaginationNavContent(GridPagination): ?HTMLTag would eliminate this shared skeleton duplication and make adding a third renderer trivial. Non-blocking — out of scope for this WP.
No other issues. The change is a clean, well-scoped Template Method correction. Code is readable and maintainable.

summary: Updated docs/agents/project-manifest/api-surface.md: replaced Bootstrap5Renderer::renderPaginationRow() (public override) with protected createPaginationRow() Template Method hook in the Bootstrap5Renderer API block. Removed createBootstrapPaginationRow() from the private helpers list (method was renamed and promoted to protected). Added inline comment explaining that guard logic is now fully inherited from BaseGridRenderer::renderPaginationRow().

Updated docs/agents/project-manifest/constraints.md: removed the Known Technical Debt row documenting Bootstrap5Renderer::renderPaginationRow() duplicating base-class guard logic — this has been resolved by WP-001.
No README changes required: the README does not document renderer internals at method-signature level.

comments.note: AC2 in the WP spec says ': string' as the return type, but both BaseGridRenderer and Bootstrap5Renderer use ': HTMLTag' (which implements StringableInterface). The api-surface.md entry uses 'HTMLTag' to match the actual code. This is consistent with QA's observation in their pipeline report.

No other documentation gaps found. The data-flows.md descriptions of renderPaginationRow() visibility rules and Bootstrap5 output remain accurate — they document the public contract, not the internal method that produces it.

notes: WP-001 PASS. All acceptance criteria met. The Template Method violation in Bootstrap5Renderer has been cleanly resolved. One low-priority improvement noted: a future createPaginationNavContent() hook method would further reduce skeleton duplication between BaseGridRenderer and Bootstrap5Renderer when a third renderer is added. Ready for documentation.
